Styling architecture in this dashboard is a **Tailwind-first setup with a small global CSS layer**, and component styling is mostly inline via `className` utilities in TSX files.

- `/Users/scottandersen/AI_accelerator/ai_projects/contractor-dashboard/tailwind.config.ts`  
  Controls Tailwind scan paths and custom theme extension. Defines custom color tokens: `background`, `surface`, `foreground`, `muted`, `neonTeal`, `accentOrange`. No custom spacing scale or plugins configured.

- `/Users/scottandersen/AI_accelerator/ai_projects/contractor-dashboard/app/globals.css`  
  Controls global baseline styles (`html/body`, box-sizing, anchor styles), dark color scheme default, and custom utility-like classes (`.bg-background`, `.bg-surface`, `.text-foreground`, `.text-muted`, `.text-neonTeal`, `.text-accentOrange`, border/hover neon variants). Also defines `.metric-card-surface` gradient/border/shadow treatment.

- `/Users/scottandersen/AI_accelerator/ai_projects/contractor-dashboard/app/layout.tsx`  
  Wires global styling into the app by importing `./globals.css`; this is the root entry point for global CSS.

- `/Users/scottandersen/AI_accelerator/ai_projects/contractor-dashboard/app/page.tsx`  
  Main dashboard page-level styling: heavy Tailwind utility usage for layout, panels, header/sidebar, dark mode classes, spacing (`p-*`, `m-*`, `gap-*`), borders, typography, and placeholder map card styling.

- `/Users/scottandersen/AI_accelerator/ai_projects/contractor-dashboard/components/metric-card.tsx`  
  Metric card component styles and mini-chart visuals. Uses Tailwind classes + `.metric-card-surface` class from globals, and renders a custom inline SVG bar sparkline (not external chart library).

- `/Users/scottandersen/AI_accelerator/ai_projects/contractor-dashboard/components/dashboard-grid.tsx`  
  Grid/card container styling and control button styling (resize/remove actions), mostly via Tailwind utility classes.

- `/Users/scottandersen/AI_accelerator/ai_projects/contractor-dashboard/components/add-metric-panel.tsx`  
  “Add Metric” panel styles (surface, borders, text states, disabled button styles), via Tailwind utilities.

- `/Users/scottandersen/AI_accelerator/ai_projects/contractor-dashboard/app/metric/[metricId]/page.tsx`  
  Detail page styles; also consumes custom color tokens like `bg-background`, `text-foreground`, `text-muted`, and neon/accent border classes.

- `/Users/scottandersen/AI_accelerator/ai_projects/contractor-dashboard/package.json`  
  Confirms styling stack dependency: `tailwindcss` present. No chart/map packages listed in direct dependencies.

### Tokens, colors, spacing
- **Color tokens:** centrally declared in `tailwind.config.ts` and mirrored/augmented in `app/globals.css`.
- **Spacing tokens:** no custom spacing tokens found; project uses Tailwind default spacing scale through utility classes.
- **Component-specific CSS files:** none found (`*.module.css` not present).

### Chart / map libraries currently used
- **External chart libs:** none found (no `recharts`, `chart.js`, `nivo`, `d3`, etc. imports or deps).
- **External map libs:** none found (no `leaflet`, `mapbox`, `react-map-gl`, etc. imports or deps).
- **Current implementation:**  
  - Charting is a **custom inline SVG** in `components/metric-card.tsx`.  
  - Map is a **styled placeholder block** in `app/page.tsx` (“Heat-style preview… replace with a live map in a later release”).
